text:
A CPU branch predictor is a hardware mechanism that guesses the outcome of conditional branch instructions before the processor has fully evaluated them. Because modern CPUs use deep pipelines to execute many instructions in parallel, waiting for a branch result would create a stall, so the predictor lets the pipeline continue by assuming a likely path.

Predictors use patterns from past behavior to make guesses. Simple designs track whether a branch has been taken or not taken
